description: Boulder County Public Works publishes a line inventory of stormwater underground pipes. The layer defines pipe identifiers, shape, material, width and height in inches, road location, ownership and maintenance fields. Its description states that the inventory combines field collection during April to December 2017 with drainage plans and later county work. These pipe geometries and dimensions provide inputs for drainage-network simulation. The DCAT description incorrectly refers to outlets; the linked layer explicitly identifies pipes and defines pipe-specific fields. That conflict is retained. The inspected metadata does not demonstrate connected hydraulic topology, complete attributes or current physical condition. Coverage is limited to the provider-described county infrastructure. Public catalogue and layer metadata are free to access. The catalogue supplies CC BY 4.0 licensing. ArcGIS layer metadata and the landing page returned HTTP 200. Export bodies and feature rows were not downloaded; distribution usability remains unverified. Related records cover other infrastructure layers in this county catalogue. The county overview has inconsistent licence wording; this record preserves the explicit layer-feed licence URL.
